item.title: Privacy Policy
item.content:encoded:
Privacy Policy

Your privacy is important to us. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information when you visit xgdebug.com.

Information We Collect

We may collect basic information about your visit to our website, such as your IP address, browser type, and the pages you view. This is done through standard web technologies (like cookies) provided by third-party services.

Third-Party Advertising

We use Google AdSense to display advertisements on this site. Google AdSense uses cookies to serve ads based on your visit to this site and other sites on the Internet.

  • You can opt out of personalized advertising by visiting Ads Settings.
  • Third-party vendors and ad networks may use cookies to serve ads on our site.

Contact Us

If you have any questions about this privacy policy, please contact us at admin@xgdebug.com.

item.title: 一只会做计划的猴子而已
item.description: 不是每个人所说的话都值得注意 —— 这是一条极好的原则。
item.content:encoded:
成长中的决定不是与周围的人协商，而是尽可能独立判断。
商量是基于你身边的人经验判断力都很高，那才有必要。 如果你缺乏判断力，肯定就认为理所当然去做了。结果就是长期下来慢慢变得和他们一样缺乏胆识和品格。 这种环境中，你只相信个人判断，反而可能是基于优秀的古人和成功过的思想家的经验。
